slides.texte_overlay:
signs you're smarter than
you give yourself credit for

you overthink things

you see every angle of a problem, even the ones nobody else noticed. overthinking is exhausting, but it comes from a mind that simply processes far more than most people's.

you question everything

you're never satisfied with the answer because that's how it's always done. needing to understand the reason behind things is the root of real intelligence, not a flaw.

you love learning odd things

you happily spend a few minutes on a random fact: why the sky is blue, how ancient rome got water. a curious mind is the clearest sign of a sharp one.
slides.texte_sophia:
you love learning odd things

i love spending 5 minutes on one random lesson: why the sky is blue, how ancient rome got water. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and a curious mind is a sharp one.

slides.texte_overlay:
you know what you don't know

you're quick to admit when you're unsure. people who know the limits of their knowledge are usually the ones who keep growing the fastest over time, year after year.

you enjoy being alone

you can spend hours alone with your thoughts without getting bored. a rich inner world is something many highly intelligent people quietly have in common.
